label: FP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink values are rememberMe.getName() = "rememberMe" + testCaseNumber (server-derived constant) and rememberMe.getValue() = rememberMeKey (cryptographically secure random value from SecureRandom). Neither value contains user-provided data. The user-provided param flows into bar variable, not into the cookie name/value used at the sink. The XSS alert incorrectly flags these server-generated strings as vulnerable.

evidence.note: Sink writes rememberMe.getName() and rememberMe.getValue() to response
rememberMe created with cookieName (derived from class name) and rememberMeKey (from SecureRandom)
param extracted from request parameters but assigned to bar, never to cookie name/value
